data.one_liner: Generates Dio client code from Retrofit‑style annotations.
data.what_it_does: It reads abstract classes annotated with @RestApi and produces concrete implementations that use Dio for HTTP calls. Supports built_collection, lean_builder and custom builder options.
use_when: You want type‑safe, compile‑time generated REST clients in Dart/Flutter
You prefer Retrofit‑style declarative API definitions over manual Dio requests
avoid_when: You need runtime‑only solutions without build_runner
You require advanced features not covered by Retrofit annotations
strengths: Integrates with build_runner and supports custom options
Keeps API definitions clean and type‑safe
weaknesses: Limited to features exposed by the package’s annotations
data.setup_notes: Add retrofit_generator and retrofit to pubspec, run flutter pub get, then execute flutter pub run build_runner build to generate code.

alternatives.name: retrofit
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides the runtime API without code generation, useful if you prefer manual client implementation

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Low‑level HTTP client; works without codegen if you want full control
